tasks.brief:
Create the file src/vortex/ui.py. This is a NEW file; write it whole in one pass.

Implementation constraints:
- No imports at all.
- No functions, no classes, no f-strings.
- The file must start with the module docstring exactly:
"""Operator dashboard shell (router phase 2). Served at "/" by app.py;
JS polls /api/* client-side."""
- Define exactly one module-level constant: UI_PAGE: str = """...""" (triple-quoted plain string, no interpolation).
- No external asset references anywhere in the string (no src="http…" or href="http…").
- No TODO comments. No print/logging.
- File must be under 300 lines.

Behavioral specification:
- Port the HTML document from examples/ui-demo/index.html into the UI_PAGE constant, keeping the structure, CSS, JS, and escaping helper intact, with these EXACT adjustments:
  - Keep the <title>vortex · model menu</title> tag verbatim.
  - Keep these element ids verbatim: ramlabel, ramfill, rows, conflict, conflictbody, down.
  - Keep the fetch URLs verbatim: /api/status, /api/catalog, /api/operations/, and action paths /api/models/{id}/load and /api/models/{id}/unload.
  - Keep button data attributes: data-act="load", data-act="unload", data-id="${...}".
  - Keep the RAM bar zones: width % with class warn above 70 and danger above 85.
  - Keep the poll interval at 2000 ms and operation poll at 500 ms.
  - Keep the daemon-down banner text mentioning :9000 and the start command .venv/bin/uvicorn vortex.app:build_app --factory --port 9000.
  - Set the footer line to: served at :9000/ by the daemon · polls /api/* every 2s.
  - Remove nothing else; keep CSS, escaping helper, and event delegation.

Acceptance condition:
- src/vortex/ui.py exists, starts with the specified module docstring, defines UI_PAGE as a plain triple-quoted str constant containing the ported HTML with all required ids, URLs, data attributes, RAM bar zones, poll intervals, daemon-down banner, and footer line, and contains no external asset references, no imports, no functions, and no f-strings.

Edit the existing file src/vortex/app.py. Use anchored SEARCH/REPLACE blocks only; do not retype unchanged content.

Implementation constraints:
- Add exactly one new import and one new route function.
- No other changes to app.py.
- No new dependencies.
- Type hints on the new function signature.
- No global mutable state.

Behavioral specification:
Edit 1 — imports: After the existing line `from .operations import OperationStore`, add exactly:
    from .ui import UI_PAGE

Edit 2 — route: Immediately BEFORE the existing line `@app.get("/v1/models")`, insert exactly:
    @app.get("/")
    def dashboard() -> Response:
        """Operator dashboard shell; JS polls /api/* client-side."""
        return Response(content=UI_PAGE, media_type="text/html")

Acceptance condition:
- src/vortex/app.py imports UI_PAGE from .ui and defines a GET / route handler named dashboard that returns Response(content=UI_PAGE, media_type="text/html"), placed before the /v1/models route, with no other modifications to the file.
